scope: Actual complete production generation + native.sight DDA; three independent VOID reveal witnesses, real 8px support/20px native body sweeps. Measurements use zero-chaos forward-facing radius; do not prove human visual quality or ordinary browser movement.

cases.searchScope: Bounded deterministic observer/chord samples; failed means the required witnesses were not found in this search, not proof that no such viewpoints exist. Three witnesses establish mechanical examples, not adequate map-wide exploration density.

diagnostics.scope: Geometric, zero-chaos forward-facing LOS diagnostics; no reward placement or human exploration claim. Open-corridor samples are axis-aligned and not exhaustive.
